integrity: Self-contained finite universal fiber and Hasse acyclicity checker; integral homotopy proof uses discrete Morse patchwork and face numbers. No independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Bidirected K_{2,q} for q>=6, with sharp 2-connectedness cutoff among q>=2; no claim for left class size>2 or full low-parameter homotopy types. Exhaustiveness of the four-external-column certificate is proved by the four-arrow bound.
title: Six-column stability for bidirected complete-bipartite multipath complexes
